title: Justified `other` classifications
description: Every selected file that received the residual class `other`, with a reason. The class exists so that a file nobody could classify is still counted rather than dropped, and this file is what stops it becoming a dumping ground: an unjustified `other` fails the build, so the residual is a place a file waits with a stated reason rather than a place it disappears. Exclude rules take precedence over this route entirely -- a path the ordered rule list excludes receives no class and needs no entry here, so a file cannot travel both.

reason.description: The closed set. Deliberately small: each value is a claim about why the class could not be decided, `unknown_artifact` being "we could not tell" and `generated_file` being "it was written by a tool rather than a person", and a third value invented at the point of use would be an excuse rather than a reason.

repo.description: Named alongside the path because a path is repo-relative, and the same path can exist in two repos.

path.description: The repo-relative path that landed in `other`.
